title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid submits for review and approval of a Firm Transportation Agreement with Hebrew Rehabilitation Center for the Aged.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. Also, the Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive and therefore grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul J. Hibbard, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating and Tim Woolf. (DPU 08-GC-19)
